marcus.name: Mike Elloian
marcus.professionalFunction: Sets stakes, gatekeeps Board access and budget
marcus.personalArc: His own reputation is riding on Project NOVA — if it fails, early retirement becomes the likely outcome. He never says this.
marcus.discoveredVia: Overheard phone call fragment in Act 3; a HR/pension letter glimpsed on his desk in Act 4; confirmed obliquely by Daniel if Mike E. Trust is high
marcus.visualDescription: Late 50s, greying, sharp but slightly rumpled suit, tired eyes that miss nothing
marcus.voiceStyle: Short, direct; dry humour under pressure; deflects personal questions with a task
marcus.recurringBeats: Coffee machine small talk (Mondays); "Never surprise me" callback (planted Act 1, paid off Act 4); interruption target in Board Meeting when Camille cuts in

camille.name: Camille Okafor
camille.professionalFunction: Voice of patient safety and regulatory rigour
camille.personalArc: Years earlier she was involved in a GMP warning letter at a previous employer. She refuses shortcuts because she has personally seen what a shortcut costs.
camille.discoveredVia: A redacted reference in an old email thread (Act 2); fully surfaces only if the player treats her position with respect rather than as an obstacle (conditional scene, Act 4)
camille.visualDescription: Early 40s, composed, lab coat over business clothes, glasses, always carries an SOP folder
camille.voiceStyle: Measured, technical, unflinchingly honest; noticeably warms once her arc surfaces
camille.recurringBeats: Industry award mention (random office event); the interrupting "Actually..." line in Board Meeting; potential opposition-to-ally reversal (Tab 5, EV-R3)

vaughn.name: Vaughn Kessler
vaughn.professionalFunction: Grounds the plan in physical reality; WBS partner
vaughn.personalArc: His daughter has just started working at Helix BioPharma. He's quietly afraid she'll inherit a facility the player got wrong.
vaughn.discoveredVia: Mentioned in passing during the WBS warehouse walk (Act 3); pays off visually in Act 6 if she appears among the control-room team
vaughn.visualDescription: Late 40s, hi-vis vest, hard hat, weathered hands, permanent site dust on his boots
vaughn.recurringBeats: Site walk-through waves — workers stop waving if morale/reputation falls; his daughter easter egg in the Act 6 crowd

daniel.name: Daniel Atwell
daniel.personalArc: His own team is being quietly downsized elsewhere in the business; proving disciplined cost control on NOVA is how he protects the headcount he has left.
daniel.discoveredVia: A budget-meeting aside in Act 3; confirmed in a Slack-style message the player can find in Act 4 if they're looking
daniel.visualDescription: Early 50s, precise dresser, glasses on a chain, laptop permanently open on a spreadsheet
daniel.voiceStyle: Speaks in costs and percentages; noticeably relaxes once he trusts the numbers are real
daniel.recurringBeats: Either becomes the player's most reliable ally or their harshest critic depending on early transparency — no visible score, just tone

priya.name: Priya Anand
priya.professionalFunction: Champions throughput/automation; source of scope-creep requests
priya.personalArc: Procurement/Ops are constantly blamed when things go wrong — she quietly enjoys proving people wrong when a bold call pays off.
priya.discoveredVia: Revealed through her own reaction lines if the player backs one of her riskier proposals and it succeeds
priya.visualDescription: Late 30s, practical workwear, tablet in hand
priya.voiceStyle: Enthusiastic, persuasive, quick to say "while we're at it..."
priya.recurringBeats: Monday coffee-machine regular; "someone stole her lunch" random office event; central to BIG-01 (the two-product curveball)

tomasz.name: Tomasz Nowak
tomasz.professionalFunction: Surfaces supplier risk; runs the three-supplier pitch
tomasz.personalArc: A new father, trying to hold a stretched personal life together while chasing suppliers at all hours.
tomasz.discoveredVia: A brief, easy-to-miss line about a sleepless night in Act 2 or 3
tomasz.voiceStyle: Understated, flags problems early and often
tomasz.recurringBeats: Central to the supplier reversal event (Tab 5, EV-R1)

aisha.name: Aisha Bello
aisha.professionalFunction: Owns the Building Management System and automation/cyber risk
aisha.personalArc: Building a case internally that automation-first careers deserve the same seniority track as engineering — NOVA is her proof point.
aisha.discoveredVia: A throwaway comment during the cyberattack response if handled well
aisha.visualDescription: 30s, headset around neck, laptop stickers from past incident call-outs
aisha.voiceStyle: Calm, precise, explains systems in plain English
aisha.recurringBeats: Small, non-mechanical scene where she demos an automation win unprompted if trust is high

ellis.name: Ellis Grant
ellis.role: Former PM — never appears in person
ellis.professionalFunction: The game's mystery and, increasingly, its conscience
ellis.personalArc: Was not incompetent — was carrying the exact same pressures the player now carries, alone, for far longer
ellis.discoveredVia: Handwritten notebook fragments scattered across all 6 acts (see Tab 6) — some prove right, some prove wrong
ellis.visualDescription: Never seen. Represented by handwriting, a desk photo, a voicemail waveform icon
ellis.voiceStyle: Notebook entries are terse, occasionally self-doubting, always specific
ellis.recurringBeats: Full reveal in Act 6 epilogue (Tab 7, END-8); notebook lines occasionally contradict each other on purpose
ellis.note: Never appears on screen — represented via handwriting/voicemail icon, not a portrait

ben.name: Ben
ben.professionalFunction: Points the player toward the artefacts that matter when an investigation could sprawl in any direction
ben.visualDescription: Provisional — fuller characterisation is being drafted separately (see reception intro content)

joan.name: Joan
joan.professionalFunction: First and last face the player sees each visit
joan.personalArc: None scripted — deliberately a low-cost, high-signal reputation mirror
joan.discoveredVia: Her greeting tone shifts with the player's overall Reputation tag (Tab 3), no dialogue tree required
joan.visualDescription: 50s, warm by default, sharp when the building is stressed
joan.voiceStyle: One line, every visit, tonally variable
joan.recurringBeats: The clearest, cheapest instance of "the world remembers" — the player will notice her tone changing before they notice anything else has

whitfield.name: Inspector Whitfield
whitfield.professionalFunction: Final Boss of Act 5 — open-question audit
whitfield.personalArc: None scripted — deliberately kept procedural and impartial
whitfield.recurringBeats: Now explicitly references the player's own old emails/decisions if they exist — 'the world remembers' made literal at the highest-stakes moment

steritech_rep.name: SteriTech Representative
steritech_rep.visualDescription: Plain jacket, no branding theatrics, carries a spec sheet not a slide deck
steritech_rep.voiceStyle: Brisk, unembellished, leads with proof not charm

rapidform_rep.name: RapidForm Representative
rapidform_rep.visualDescription: Energetic, delivery-tracker app open before she's finished sitting down
rapidform_rep.voiceStyle: Fast, confident, sells on time saved

pharmacraft_rep.name: PharmaCraft Precision Representative
pharmacraft_rep.visualDescription: Senior engineer, portfolio of validation certificates instead of a brochure
pharmacraft_rep.voiceStyle: Measured, proud, sells on track record
